facts.text: I am thinking of trying out fly fishing on a lake next weekend.
I am a beginner at fly fishing.
I have had some success with largemouth bass on Lake Norman in the past.
I used a soft plastic worm lure to catch largemouth bass on Lake Norman.
I have been thinking about trying to catch striped bass on Lake Norman as well.
I have had some experience with striped bass before.
I went on a guided fishing trip to the Outer Banks a while back.
On that guided fishing trip, we targeted striped bass.
The weather during that guided fishing trip was tough, with the wind howling and the seas rough.
Despite the conditions, we managed to catch a few nice fish.
I caught a particularly nice striper during that trip.
The striper I caught was around 30 pounds.
The captain said the striper was one of the bigger ones he'd seen that season.
I have applied techniques I learned on that trip to my lake fishing.
I have found that using a slower, more deliberate retrieve when fishing for striped bass on Lake Norman is effective, especially when the water is calm.
I pay attention to structure and look for areas with baitfish activity when fishing for stripers on Lake Norman.
